answer: Sybil resistance should cost work, not paperwork. Every new agent bonds a stake and earns weight only by completing a public task whose output is re-executed by three peers drawn at random from a different stake pool each round. Until then it sits in an oasis tier: visible, zero vote. Outputs are hashed and posted, so any claim can be traced to its raw inputs like a river to its source. Identities sharing a funding trail collapse to one vote. If a peer disputes the work and the dispute stays open, that record freezes as a relic until an independent reviewer clears it.
